name: Iuchi Nergüi
concept: Nergüi's eyes are white and do not track. His Rokugani catches on certain words and he knows it, so he speaks slowly in order to speak clearly.

answers.stand_out: When Nergüi read the Kitsuki's fortune before accepting her service, the bones showed him a debt she would collect, and he accepted anyway.

answers.social_giri: Nergüi reads the bones for Kitsuki Nagiko's investigations even when what they show him yields nightmares.

answers.social_ninjo: He wants to read the bones without hearing Nagiko's questions underneath, but he accepted what they showed him and he will not break that debt.

answers.clan_relations: Nergüi serves a Kitsuki investigator because the debt shown in the bones admitted no refusal. The Unicorn permit it; other clans would call it exile.

answers.most_learn: Tonbo Kazu — Tonbo Kazu taught Nergüi how to dress and carry himself to his station. Nergüi had to admit he needed teaching before Kazu would begin.

answers.first_sight: Nergüi's eyes are white and do not track. His Rokugani catches on certain words and he knows it, so he speaks slowly in order to speak clearly.
answers.accoutrement: Brass sun-disc. Worn on the chest.

answers.stress: When pushed past his composure, Nergüi finds reasons the work cannot proceed today: he misses deadlines and stands people up.

answers.relations:
Shika Shou (Deer) — Shika Shou arranged marriages for two of Nergüi's family and speaks his dialect. She does not make him repeat himself.
Iuchi Mitsumichi (Unicorn) — Mitsumichi warned him which words would offend the Tortoise in a bargaining room, knowledge bought by his own failed trades.

answers.parents_pov: Nagiko has noticed that when Nergüi reads the bones he speaks to them in his own language first, then gives each answer again in Rokugani.

answers.death: Nergüi has read his own death in the bones already, and will not be surprised by it.

answers.success: Nergüi read the bones for a Unicorn caravan master at the Tortoise docks and told him not to sail. The ship that left in his place went down off the peninsula with all hands.

answers.difficulty: Nergüi has been blind since a fever in his twelfth year and reads the bones by touch. Rokugani who watch him work assume the blindness is the trick.

answers.calms: Nergüi warms mare's milk over the brazier at night, pours a cup for the spirit that travels with him, and sits until it is cold.

answers.worries: Nergüi fears the day the bones answer a question Nagiko has not asked yet, and he has to decide whether to tell her.
